item.title: About
item.description:
Burak Can Kaya

M.A. candidate in Interdisciplinary Studies of the Middle East at Freie Universität Berlin. A dedicated humanitarian professional with extensive experience in field operations, monitoring and evaluation, and emergency response, having served in international and national organizations across Türkiye and beyond.

Reporting Officer

Turkish Red Crescent

Ankara, Türkiye
June 2024 – October 2024

  • Prepared Power BI dashboards and visual reports showcasing project performance over 5 years.
  • Collaborated with program teams to translate data into strategic insights.
  • Ensured data accuracy and consistency with M&E and IT departments.
  • Developed reporting templates and visualization tools aligned with donor requirements.
  • Contributed to monthly and quarterly narrative reports.

Field Officer

International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)

Gaziantep, Türkiye
July 2023 – December 2023

  • Supported earthquake recovery as part of the Emergency Response Unit (ERU).
  • Joined field visits and ESSN coordination meetings.
  • Built data visualizations using Power BI.
  • Conducted joint field missions with TRC teams.
  • Participated in coordination meetings and supported field-level planning and monitoring.
  • Flagged protection/outreach/SASF issues to IFRC management.
  • Liaised with local authorities, UN agencies, and NGOs.

Field Assistant

International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)

Gaziantep, Türkiye
May 2022 – July 2023

  • Supported earthquake recovery as part of the ERU.
  • Attended field visits and meetings for the ESSN Project.
  • Managed finance, administration, logistics at IFRC Gaziantep Office.
  • Prepared dashboards in Power BI based on team needs.
  • Liaised with Finance, Admin, Logistics, Procurement, and IM teams in Ankara.
  • Oversaw drivers, security, and cleaning staff in Gaziantep office.

International Key Account Manager

Vestel International

Manisa, Türkiye
January 2022 – May 2022

  • Managed 11+ clients across six countries with $42.5M annual turnover.
  • Handled full sales cycle from offers to payments and shipments.
  • Promoted new products during client visits and international expos.
  • Tracked market trends and responded with R&D launches.

Business Intelligence Intern

Migrapreneur

Berlin, Germany
June 2021 – September 2021

  • Researched migrant entrepreneurship in Germany (Turkish, Polish, Italian).
  • Authored reports and insights to improve business intelligence.

Volunteer – Data Collection & Mapping

Go For (Youth Organizations Forum)

Ankara, Türkiye
August 2020 – June 2021

  • Collected and analyzed youth rights violation data during COVID-19.
  • Conducted literature reviews and supported reporting & mapping efforts.

Master’s Degree, Interdisciplinary Studies of the Middle East

Freie Universität Berlin

Berlin, Germany
September 2024 – Present

  • Coursework focuses on the politics, cultures, and societies of the Middle East.
  • Interdisciplinary approach including history, sociology, and political science.
  • Emphasis on academic research and field-related writing.

Bachelor’s Degree, Political Science and Public Administration

Hacettepe University

Ankara, Türkiye
September 2016 – June 2021

  • Completed core courses in political theory, public policy, and international relations.
  • Participated in student initiatives and academic conferences.
  • Built strong foundations in administrative and institutional structures.

Exchange Program, Political Science and International Relations

École de Gouvernance et d'Économie

Rabat, Morocco
September 2019 – January 2020

  • Selected for Erasmus+ exchange program.
  • Focused on North African politics, governance, and Euro-Mediterranean relations.
  • Gained international academic exposure and cross-cultural experience.
